text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I head to training, I spot
Matikanefukukitaru
standing very still, a
horrified look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The whole area is awash in a carpet of yellow-green! Oh, what do I do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can run today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calm her down so she can explain what
she's so
flustered about.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My unlucky color today is yellow-green,
you see...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which means that all the turf around us
is going
to bring me bad luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'll end up cursing myself for life if I run
on the
track right now! Gah! I don't even
wanna think
about that! Running is just
not an option today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but I'm taking the day off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to invalidate her beliefs, but
it seems
excessive to let her skip a whole
day of training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ask her if there's anything we can do to
let her
train without worrying about her
unlucky color.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Interesting question. Taking
matters into
our own hands is certainly a
novel approach...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not like we can dye the turf
another
color...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Unless...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I've got it! Wait here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a moment, she comes rushing
back... with a
pair of sunglasses.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I found a solution! If I put these on, the
dreaded
yellow-green hues around us
will look like a
harmless dull brown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll try it out right away!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! My guess was right! Everything's
brown now!
Hooray!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In fact, the training grounds feel even
more
mystical bathed in sepia tones! Oh,
how
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's worth thinking outside the
box
sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now I won't have to worry about running
into
anything yellow-green! Ah, what a
blessed day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her sunglasses,
Matikanefukukitaru is
full of energy for
the entire training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her bright enthusiasm puts the others in
a good
mood too, and they have a good
time at training.
